blurb: Guests can rent single and tandem kayaks, including sit on top and sit in models, as well as stand up paddleboards. Kids 0-7 years old can paddle with an adult in sit on top kayaks; kids 7 years and older (40+ lbs) can paddle alone in child sit on tops. The marina also offers a snack shack, a store with local goods, a private beach, and guest moorage.
